impersonal.en: The automated reply sounded impersonal despite its polite wording.
impersonal.zh: 自動回覆雖然措辭有禮，仍顯得缺乏人情味。

impolite.en: It is impolite to interrupt while someone else is speaking.
impolite.zh: 別人說話時打斷對方是不禮貌的。

impractical.en: The first plan was impractical because it required too much time.
impractical.zh: 第一個計畫因需要太多時間而不切實際。

inability.en: His inability to access the file delayed the presentation.
inability.zh: 他無法存取檔案，延誤了簡報。

inappropriate.en: The teacher removed an inappropriate comment from the class forum.
inappropriate.zh: 老師從班級論壇移除了一則不適當留言。

incidentally.en: Incidentally, the library will stay open later tomorrow evening.
incidentally.zh: 順帶一提，圖書館明晚會延長開放。

inclination.en: She has a natural inclination toward solving logic problems.
inclination.zh: 她天生傾向喜歡解邏輯問題。

incomplete.en: The assignment was incomplete because one section was missing.
incomplete.zh: 這份作業因缺少一個部分而不完整。

inconvenient.en: The temporary entrance is inconvenient but still easy to find.
inconvenient.zh: 臨時入口雖然不方便，但仍很容易找到。

indecision.en: Too much indecision can slow a group's progress significantly.
indecision.zh: 過度猶豫會大幅拖慢小組進度。

independently.en: Students completed the first part independently before comparing answers.
independently.zh: 學生先獨立完成第一部分，再互相比對答案。

indicator.en: Attendance can be one indicator of student engagement.
indicator.zh: 出席率可以是學生投入程度的一項指標。

indigestion.en: The health article mentions indigestion as a common digestive complaint.
indigestion.zh: 健康文章提到消化不良是一種常見的消化問題。

indignation.en: The unfair decision caused widespread indignation among local residents.
indignation.zh: 這項不公平決定引起當地居民普遍憤慨。

indirect.en: The author makes an indirect reference to the earlier event.
indirect.zh: 作者間接提到了先前的事件。

indistinct.en: The distant mountains looked indistinct through the morning mist.
indistinct.zh: 遠方山脈在晨霧中顯得模糊不清。

industrious.en: The industrious student reviewed notes regularly throughout the semester.
industrious.zh: 這位勤奮學生整學期都規律複習筆記。

ineffective.en: The old method proved ineffective after several careful trials.
ineffective.zh: 經過幾次仔細測試後，舊方法被證明效果不佳。

inefficient.en: The outdated process was inefficient and wasted valuable time.
inefficient.zh: 過時流程效率低落，也浪費寶貴時間。

inexpensive.en: The club found an inexpensive way to print its posters.
inexpensive.zh: 社團找到一種便宜的海報印製方式。

inference.en: The students made an inference from clues in the passage.
inference.zh: 學生根據文章中的線索做出推論。

influenza.en: The article explains how influenza can spread through communities.
influenza.zh: 文章說明流感如何在社區中傳播。

informal.en: The club held an informal discussion after the official meeting.
informal.zh: 正式會議後，社團進行了一場非正式討論。

ingenuity.en: The simple invention showed remarkable ingenuity and careful planning.
ingenuity.zh: 這項簡單發明展現出非凡巧思與仔細規劃。

initially.en: Initially, the group disagreed but later reached a compromise.
initially.zh: 起初小組意見不合，後來達成妥協。

inquisitive.en: An inquisitive student often asks thoughtful questions in class.
inquisitive.zh: 好奇心強的學生常在課堂上提出有深度的問題。

insecure.en: The shelf felt insecure until the loose support was fixed.
insecure.zh: 鬆動支架修好前，架子感覺不穩固。

inspiring.en: Her speech was inspiring and encouraged students to keep learning.
inspiring.zh: 她的演講很鼓舞人心，鼓勵學生持續學習。

instability.en: Political instability can make long-term planning more difficult.
instability.zh: 政治不穩定可能讓長期規劃更加困難。

shaft.en: Sunlight entered through a narrow shaft between the buildings.
shaft.zh: 一道陽光從建築物之間的狹窄縫隙照進來。

shear.en: Strong winds can shear small branches from weakened trees.
shear.zh: 強風可能把脆弱樹木的小枝折斷。

shipment.en: The bookstore received a new shipment of textbooks this morning.
shipment.zh: 書店今天早上收到一批新的教科書。

shocked.en: The students were shocked by the unexpected change in schedule.
shocked.zh: 學生對突如其來的時程變更感到震驚。

shocking.en: The report revealed a shocking amount of wasted food.
shocking.zh: 報告揭露了令人震驚的食物浪費量。

should.en: Students should review their sources before submitting a report.
should.zh: 學生在繳交報告前應檢查資料來源。

silently.en: The audience waited silently for the performance to begin.
silently.zh: 觀眾安靜等待表演開始。

similarly.en: The second group similarly reported improved results after practice.
similarly.zh: 第二組同樣回報練習後的結果有所改善。

simultaneously.en: Both screens displayed the same message simultaneously during the test.
simultaneously.zh: 測試時兩個螢幕同時顯示相同訊息。

sinister.en: The story creates a sinister mood through darkness and silence.
sinister.zh: 故事透過黑暗與寂靜營造陰森氣氛。

sitter.en: The portrait shows a sitter facing a bright window.
sitter.zh: 這幅肖像畫呈現一名坐姿人物面向明亮窗戶。

situate.en: The architect chose to situate the entrance beside the garden.
situate.zh: 建築師選擇把入口設在花園旁。

situated.en: The library is situated near the center of campus.
situated.zh: 圖書館位於校園中央附近。

six.en: Six students volunteered to help prepare the exhibition.
six.zh: 有六名學生自願協助準備展覽。

sixteen.en: Sixteen teams entered the regional science competition this year.
sixteen.zh: 今年共有十六隊參加區域科學競賽。

sixty.en: The museum tour lasts about sixty minutes in total.
sixty.zh: 博物館導覽總共約六十分鐘。

sizable.en: The project attracted a sizable audience during the school fair.
sizable.zh: 這項專題在校慶期間吸引了相當多觀眾。

slug.en: A small slug moved slowly across the damp garden path.
slug.zh: 一隻小蛞蝓慢慢爬過潮濕的花園小徑。

socially.en: The club helps new students connect socially with classmates.
socially.zh: 社團幫助新生在社交上與同學建立連結。

sociological.en: The study takes a sociological approach to changes in family life.
sociological.zh: 這項研究以社會學觀點探討家庭生活的變化。

sodium.en: The science label lists sodium among the substances in the sample.
sodium.zh: 科學標籤把鈉列為樣本中的成分之一。
